mapper.select: WITH temp_agent_user AS ( SELECT DISTINCT u.parent_id FROM p_user_proc p INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.id = p.id AND u.user_type != 1 WHERE p.proc_type = 5 AND p.id BETWEEN #{fromId} AND #{toId} GROUP BY u.parent_id ) SELECT u.parent_id,u.market_site_id, SUM(u.activate_status ) AS sub_valid_user_count FROM temp_agent_user au INNER JOIN s_user u ON u.parent_id = au.parent_id AND u.user_type != 1 GROUP BY u.parent_id,u.market_site_id
